prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
engine_stated_criteria: A strong starting point is Serrano Orthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist—the right choice depends on your bite, treatment goals, budget, and location. **A strong starting point is Serrano Orthodontics**: its Phoenix practice offers metal and clear braces as well as Invisalign, and the practice says both orthodontists are board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics. It also reports 400+ five-star Google reviews across its Phoenix and Chandler offices. [Practice details](https://serranoorthodontics.com/welcome/) · [Credentials and treatments](https://serranoorthodontics.com/phoenix-orthodontics/)

**Dunn Orthodontics** is another option to compare; it offers braces and Invisalign in Phoenix and says its orthodontists are board-certified. [Practice details](https://dunn-orthodontics.com/)

Before choosing, get two or three consultations and compare the proposed treatment plan, total cost, what’s included (such as retainers and refinements), and who will supervise your care. Ask whether Invisalign is suitable for your specific bite—aligners aren’t the best fit for every case.
